name: AlternativeCommerce PayPal Checkout
description: PayPal payment gateway for the Basket (AlternativeCommerce) store, calling PayPal's server-side Orders API plus JS SDK Smart Buttons.
project_description:
This module provides a Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket) payment method to embed the payment services provided by https://www.paypal.com/ .

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket) 
 
 Back to top 

 Setup 
 
 After installation, go to the payment systems settings page /admin/basket/settings-payment . 
 Create a payment point and indicate in the service "PayPal". 
 After you create, you will have a button to go to the settings page of the payment gateway itself.
